## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Change Classification

- [ ] Software-only
- [ ] Motion-affecting
- [ ] Machine-control

## Verification

- [ ] Focused automated tests
- [ ] Full automated test suite
- [ ] Architecture checks
- [ ] NX/ground-truth comparison

Verification details:

## Safety Impact

Explain possible effects on motion, machine state, deployment, or operator
decisions. Write `None` only when clearly true.

## Deployment and Rollback

State deployment steps, machine-state files requiring preservation, and the
rollback commit or package.

## Documentation and Handoff

- [ ] `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md` updated if project or machine status changed
- [ ] `docs/RISK_REGISTER.md` updated if risks changed
- [ ] Session note or handoff added when needed
- [ ] Change is clearly labeled software-verified or machine-verified
